build 463 date 20261030 time 080702
PureMetal Forge - Anvil, the Raspberry Pi 4 monitor. Version 2.0,
64-bit AArch64, running with no operating system underneath it.
  This is build 463 of this board's monitor, made 2026-10-30 at 08:07:02.
  The number is raised by one by every successful build, so two images
  can be told apart from the prompt. It says WHICH build this is, not
  WHAT is in it - a number can be reset, frozen, or carried by a source
  somebody edited without rebuilding. The digest below is what is in it.
  This monitor's own image is 6666700 bytes, 00200000 .. 0085B9CB.
  That extent is the RUNNING IMAGE's own: the compiler marks the end
  of the image with a symbol and this program reads it, so the length
  is of the code that is executing and not of a file on a disk that
  may since have been replaced. It is also why this monitor has no
  maximum size - type map.
  That size and the build number above are enough to tell two images
  apart. For the digest that says WHAT is in it, type:
    version full        - or crc32 00200000 0065B9CC
  It is not done here unasked because it reads every byte of the
  image, which is not instant on a board with its caches off.
  Built by PureMetal Forge for target pi4.
  This image is a kernel8.img. The firmware loads the whole file to
  00200000 and enters it there, with no loader in between -
  which is why its size is not capped by anything: there is nothing
  above it in the boot path to make room for.
  The compiler and linker versions are not stamped into the image, so -
  unlike U-Boot's version - they are not printed here rather than
  guessed at.
  Type info for the board, revision and clocks, or help for the commands.
pmf>
